Question 3

Consider the curve defined parametrically as x=5t+1,y=t2,t∈[0,3]. What integral gives the surface area generated when this curve is rotated 2π radians about the x-axis?

a
5π∫03t2(5t+1)dt
b
2π∫03t225+4t2dt
c
10π∫03t5+2t2dt
d
2π∫03(5t+1)25+2tdt
e
10π∫03t3dt
